pieces.Text: As a standard action, a dragonkin can breathe a 30-foot cone of flame that deals 1d6 fire damage. At 3rd level, a dragonkin adds 1-1/2 x his character level to the damage. A creature in the cone can attempt a Reflex save for half damage (DC = 10 + half the dragonkin's character level + his Constitution modifier). A dragonkin can't use this ability again until he has taken a 10-minute rest to recover Stamina Points.
